name: WebcamChannels
description: TauSync meeting-word identifiers for the webcam streaming protocol. Android streams camera frames to PC over a persistent channel.

members.name: WEBCAM_START
members.description: Android sends a start signal to PC. PC opens the virtual camera in response.

members.name: WEBCAM_FRAMES
members.description: Android streams JPEG frames continuously to PC. Channel stays open for the duration of the session.
